records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. We look at research studies to try to understand if an exposure, like amitriptyline, might increase the chance of birth defects in a pregnancy. A small number of human studies have not found a higher chance for birth defects with doses of amitriptyline used for treatment of depression.
records.source_section: Does taking amitriptyline increase the chance of birth defects?
